summary: Scattered pages from The Green Hills of Stranglethorn have been gathered into Chapter I. Barnil is assembling the chapters for Master Nesingwary’s manuscript.

sections.title: Scattered Pages
sections.body: A gust swept through Master Nesingwary’s camp and scattered the pages of his manuscript across Stranglethorn. Barnil gathered many, but pages for all four chapters were still missing. This chapter belongs to the book Barnil is piecing together, and he is ready to organize the pages once they are found.

faq.answer: Chapter I is one of the four parts of Master Nesingwary’s scattered manuscript, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.
Barnil is helping assemble Master Nesingwary’s manuscript and asks for the chapters once they are complete.
A large gust of wind blew through Master Nesingwary’s camp and scattered pages of the manuscript across the jungle.

faq.q: Who wrote The Green Hills of Stranglethorn?
faq.answer: Master Nesingwary is the author of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn, a novel Barnil is helping assemble.
